capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Audi US 2024 release: "82-kilowatt-hour battery (77 kWh of net capacity)". Wikipedia: Q4 40/45/50 82 gross for 2021-mid 2024; the 2025 Q4 45 uses the same pack (Cars.com).

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Audi US 2024 release: 77 kWh net. Same 82/77 pack in 2022-2026 (Wikipedia).

chemistry.notes: Wikipedia: "Nickel-Manganese-Cobalt (NMC) battery cells" (LG Energy Solution, CATL).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: the Q4 e-tron uses the MEB platform and its 82 kWh pack; Guide Auto lists the same-platform VW ID.4 82 kWh pack at 400 V. No Audi page states the Q4 voltage.

preconditioning.notes: Audi US 2024 release (via InsideEVs): the route planner prioritises DC fast chargers and will thermally precondition the battery before charging. A manual control is not described (low confidence).

dc_max_kw.notes: Audi US 2024 release: Q4 55 e-tron up to 175 kW, 10-80 % in 28 min.

ac_max_kw.notes: Audi US 2024 release (via InsideEVs): 11 kW onboard charger, full recharge overnight (up to 12 h).

published_10_80_min.notes: Audi US: 10-80 % in 28 minutes (82 kWh pack, 175 kW).
